Full summary: Test-adequacy review of 04cc90b (creation-time provisional status): full suite passes (108 files, 1428 passed, 2 pre-existing skips); new triage test verified running on both file and sqlite backends; found 4 coverage gaps — record-path invalid-status error contract untested (probe confirmed partial-success with decision_errors), decide rejection test only asserts toContain("error"), post-promote persisted status unasserted, promote_provisionals description warning unpinned.
Findings: Test callTool helpers reach into _registeredTools and invoke handlers directly, bypassing zod — so the decide 'rejects superseded' test genuinely exercises the engine guard, and the same bypass is the untested surface on the record path; sqlite getIndex() derives index entries by parsing the data blob (same source as get()), so index/record status disagreement is structurally impossible on sqlite; the status COLUMN is written but never read by any query (only idx_decisions_status exists); Invalid status through twining_record returns partial success: bad decision dropped into decision_errors with the engine message, remaining decisions still created — verified by direct probe, not covered by any test
